title: Dimensional Analysis - Practice Set 1
notes: Q1. Find the dimensional formula of Force.
Solution: Force = mass × acceleration = mass × velocity/time = mass × (length/time)/time
Q2. Find the dimensional formula of Work and Energy.
Q3. Find the dimensional formula of Power.
Q4. Find the dimensional formula of Pressure.
Q5. Using the principle of homogeneity, verify whether the equation v = u + at is dimensionally correct.
Since both terms of R.H.S. have the same dimension [LT⁻¹], addition is valid.
Q6. Check the dimensional correctness of s = ut + ½at².
Both terms reduce to [L], and ½ is a dimensionless constant, so it doesn't affect the check.
